subject: Forecasted token bucket & approval path — next steps and PO thresholds
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Maya Johnson <m.johnson@orchard.ai>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@orchard.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Forecasted token bucket & approval path — next steps and PO thresholds

Thanks again for the call earlier, Maya — appreciate the time to walk through the Orchards use case. Quick recap and the asks we landed on so we can align on procurement timing:

Summary (from our notes)
- Product: in-app summarization + question-answering for structured workflows
- Expected production traffic ramp: 10k MAUs in Q1 ramping to 40k MAUs by month 6
- Per-user activity: avg ~1.8 sessions/day, ~220 tokens/session (prompt + response)

Preliminary monthly token math (please confirm)
- Conservative month 1: 10k MAUs * 1.8 * 220 = ~3.96B tokens/month (~4.0B)
- Mid ramp (month 3): 20k MAUs -> ~7.92B tokens/month (~7.9B)
- Target steady state (month 6+): 40k MAUs -> ~15.84B tokens/month (~15.8B)

What we need from you to finalize pricing path:
1) Confirm the MAU/usage assumptions above (or paste your internal estimate).
2) Which monthly spend band do you expect to budget for year-one (options below):
   - Starter: up to $5k/month
   - Growth: $5k–$50k/month
   - Committed: $50k–$250k/month
   - Enterprise: $250k+/month
3) Procurement constraints: does Orchard require a PO for any purchase? Is there a minimum PO threshold (e.g., $10k, $25k, $50k)?

Pricing orientation (for transparency)
- For reference, our published target unit economics (example): $X — we typically negotiate committed band pricing by monthly token commitment and annual term. Rough starting bands we discussed on-call: $350–$800 per 1M tokens depending on model family, quantization, and commit. We can provide explicit $/1M token tiers once you confirm the band above.

Attachments: I attached a quick volume estimate workbook (Orchard-Monthly-Volume-Estimate.xlsx) and our standard PO threshold summary (PO-thresholds.pdf) to help you surface internal procurement questions.

Next steps
- Maya: confirm the usage assumptions + tentative preferred spend band this week if possible.
- Aaron: confirm procurement PO threshold and contracting lead for Redwood PO/SOW.
- Redwood (Aditya/Marissa): we'll prepare a 3-band pricing sketch tied to monthly commit bands once we get the confirmation above.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment: Orchard-Monthly-Volume-Estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
Attachment: PO-thresholds.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
From: Maya Johnson <m.johnson@orchard.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@orchard.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecasted token bucket & approval path — next steps and PO thresholds

Thanks, Karthik — great summary. Quick clarifications (we pulled the numbers with our product analytics):
- Confirmed: 10,200 MAUs baseline (Nov), projected to 38k MAUs by end of Q2.
- Session avg: 1.7 sessions/day, ~240 tokens/session (we're seeing slightly longer responses).

Revised monthly token estimates (rounded):
- Month 0 (Nov baseline): ~4.2B tokens/month
- Month 3 (mid ramp): ~8.6B tokens/month
- Month 6+: ~17.6B tokens/month

Procurement note: Orchard requires a PO for purchases > $25,000. Smaller pilots can be credit-card paid but anything that hits the $25k threshold needs procurement involvement and standard PO routing. Our procurement contact is Aaron (cc'd) and legal prefers a one-page SOW + PO for product integrations.

On pricing bands: We would likely aim for the Committed band ($50k–$250k/month) given the ramp profile, but we need to see the $/1M token sketches to map to our budget.

Happy to set a quick follow-up with Aaron + your team if needed.

Cheers,
Maya Johnson
Head of Product | Orchard AI
m.johnson@orchard.ai
--
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Maya Johnson <m.johnson@orchard.ai>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@orchard.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecasted token bucket & approval path — next steps and PO thresholds

Great — thanks for the confirmation, Maya. Updated math looks consistent with our initial sketch. A couple of concrete items from our side so you can present internally:

1) Example $/1M token sketches (illustrative, pre-negotiation):
   - No commit / pay-as-you-go: ~$800 per 1M tokens (depends on model family)
   - Small commit (3–12 month): ~$520–$650 per 1M tokens
   - Mid commit (12 month, higher band): ~$320–$480 per 1M tokens
   - Enterprise commit (annual + >$1.5M annual spend): custom pricing, typically <$300 per 1M tokens

2) If Orchard expects month-6 volumes ~17.6B tokens, monthly spend at each sketch would be approximately:
   - PAYG: 17.6B / 1M * $800 = ~$14,080,000/month (obviously not realistic long-term)
   - Mid commit (assume $400/1M): 17.6B * $400 / 1M = ~$7,040,000/month

3) Procurement path + PO threshold notes (from your comment):
   - Since Orchard needs POs > $25k, short pilots can run on card credits; anything that crosses $25k will need a PO + SOW.
   - For initial commercial terms we typically propose a quarterly billing cadence on PO or monthly invoices on larger POs; we will mirror whatever your procurement team needs.

Ask: can Aaron confirm the internal PO approval SLA (e.g., 7–14 business days) and whether your finance requires vendor setup before issuing POs? That will determine how quickly we can start once a band is agreed.

Next steps (action owners):
- Aaron: confirm PO threshold process & vendor setup SLA (asked).
- Maya: confirm preferred commit band (Committed or Enterprise) so we can draft a 3-option pricing sheet.
- Redwood (Aditya): can you prepare a first-pass commit-tier sketch and a suggested contract cadence (quarterly invoicing vs annual prepay) — cc'd to own that.

I'll wait for Aaron's procurement note and then push a sketch to HubSpot + Drive.

Best,
Karthik
--
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Maya Johnson <m.johnson@orchard.ai>, Aaron Lee <aaron.lee@orchard.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecasted token bucket & approval path — next steps and PO thresholds

Looping in a quick internal note (and leaving on the thread for transparency):
- I'll put together a 3-tier pricing sketch by EOD (Committed / Mid / Enterprise) that maps to the token bands Karthik listed. Will include: token $/1M, expected monthly spend, and sample billing cadence options.
- If Aaron confirms a 7–14 day PO approval SLA, we can propose an initial 3-month pilot on PO (quarterly invoices) to bridge to annual commit once volumes stabilize. That avoids CC limits and meets Orchard procurement policy.
- If Orchard is targeting the Committed band, recommend we include a ramp credit structure in the SOW (month 1–3 blended pricing) to reduce sticker shock as they scale to full volume.

Maya/Aaron — when you confirm the procurement lead (if Aaron is the right contact) and internal SLA, we'll drop the draft pricing and a one-page SOW template to the Drive link I shared.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
